scientific.integrity: The source AdaSGDMax running-maximum second-moment recurrence is specialized exactly to an isotropic quadratic at zero second-moment memory. The resulting radial max recurrence is solved completely, including its exceptional resonance and supercritical reset.
limitations: Zero second-moment memory and no momentum in the analyzed source-theory slice.
Large transient spikes can occur even when the asymptotic dynamics are stable.

title: AdaSGDMax has an exact overshoot-rate reciprocity
